conservation.condition_narrative: "in Lucite – 46 . . . and isobutyl . . . in solvent mixture . . . benzene #1 25% . . . cond street" (typed, half-missing label).
conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

cr_data.provenance: Mr. and Mrs. Eugene McDermott, Dallas, Texas, gift, 1966; Sally and Mitchell Wilder, Fort Worth, Texas, gift, 1966; James Maroney, Inc., New York, NY, 1980; Private collection, Millbrook, New York, 1981; Christie's, New York, NY, sale, no. 8886, lot no. 183, 21 May 1998 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Painted 1937. On permanent loan from Miss O'Keeffe to Mr. Rodakiewicz." Pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 67. Henwar Rodakiewicz, a filmmaker, was a friend of O'Keeffe and Stieglitz. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Red Hills with White Cloud

description: Smooth red hills stretch across the landscape. An arroyo cuts through the right side of the scene. A blue sky with a single white cloud stretches out above the hill.
title: Red Hills with White Cloud
